question:
Refer to the exhibit. An engineer is implementing an ERSPAN configuration to mirror web server traffic connected to N7K-2. Which ERSPAN configuration must be applied on N7K-1 to forward traffic to the network analyzer?
! ERSPAN Source Configuration
N7k-2(config)# monitor session 1 type erspan-source
N7k-2(config-erspan-src)# erspan-id 100
N7k-2(config-erspan-src)# vrf default
N7k-2(config-erspan-src)# destination ip 192.168.16.55
N7k-2(config-erspan-src)# source interface ethernet 2/10
N7k-2(config-erspan-src)# no shut
N7k-2(config-erspan-src)# exit
N7k-2(config)# monitor erspan origin ip-address 192.168.16.10 global
context: Topology: N7K-1 (192.168.16.55) has Eth1/5 to Network Analyzer (10.10.11.1) and Eth1/30.10 to IP Cloud (L3), which connects to N7K-2 (Eth2/10 to Web Server).
imageNote: Diagram: N7K-1 (192.168.16.55) has Eth1/5 to Network Analyzer (10.10.11.1) and Eth1/30.10 to an IP Cloud (L3), which connects to N7K-2 (Eth2/10 to Web Server).
